retainedPatches.rationale: The pinned browser distribution needs a parser-compatible function wrapper so Angular can bundle the lazy RDKit adapter without changing the vendor API or eager bundle boundary.
retainedPatches.behavioralImpact: Keeps lazy RDKit initialization and browser molecule rendering available while preserving the approved CommonJS exception.
retainedPatches.removalCondition: Remove when the selected @rdkit/rdkit release ships a browser distribution accepted by the Angular builder without this wrapper delta.

retainedPatches.rationale: Mailer 2.3.7 uses namespace imports as transport class types and declares message defaults as transport options, which conflicts with Nodemailer 10 types.
retainedPatches.behavioralImpact: Corrects declaration types for Nodemailer 10 without changing mail delivery at runtime.
retainedPatches.removalCondition: Remove when the selected mailer release supports Nodemailer 10 transport class imports and MailDefaults in its declarations.

removedPatches.reason: The current dependency graph governs minimatch through package-manager overrides; no repository patch remains or is required.
The Fastify integration now uses the resolved supported release without a repository patch.
